Re-score C2-naive and C1-nohardening on the NEW runs so all conditions share one ground-truth basis (no cross-run contamination from the May archive)
Assemble the unified C1-full / C1-nohardening / C2-naive / C3-Elastic matrix with point estimates + 95% bootstrap CIs

scope_recommendation: Take the floor as ONE C1-full run per condition (C1-full, and re-scored C1-nohardening + C2-naive) over the full ground-truth event set of a single representative new run — NOT all 10 runs blindly. C1-full via Harness A is LLM-costly and unmeasured; committing to 10 runs before measuring per-run cost risks burning budget without finishing the paper. Floor = 1 run/condition with the FULL event corpus (preserves per-event statistics for bootstrap CIs over events). Stretch = expand C1-full to 3 runs IF Managers' measured cost shows a single run completes within an acceptable LLM budget/time, enabling run-level CIs. A single full run with event-level bootstrap CIs is a defensible, publishable claim; the matrix's internal consistency (same runs/labels across conditions) matters more than run count.
phasing: Phase 0 (Managers, BLOCKING research, no LLM spend): map C1-full/C1-nohardening/C2 onto the new attack runs, confirm ground-truth labels exist for those runs (or generate them deterministically from labels.jsonl + the attack orchestrator output), and MEASURE the LLM cost/time of one C1-full event-classification pass on a small probe (e.g. 10 events) before committing. Phase 1 (data generation, sequential-then-parallel): pick the representative run; run C1-full via Harness A on its full ground-truth set; in PARALLEL re-score C2-naive (c2_naive_helper.py, no live LLM) and C1-nohardening on the same run; compute_metrics + compute_fpr + bootstrap_ci for all four conditions. Phase 2 (paper, can start drafting tables/prose in parallel with Phase 1 using placeholders that are FILLED only from real artifacts): write Results + Discussion past tense, insert the matrix, wire reproducibility subsection, compile to PDF and iterate to zero errors. Gate between phases: Phase 1 may not start until Phase 0's cost probe confirms feasibility and label availability.
conditions: Managers MUST measure C1-full per-event LLM cost on a small probe and confirm new-run ground-truth labels exist BEFORE committing to a run count — no open-ended C1-full launch.

All four conditions MUST be scored on the SAME new run(s) and SAME ground-truth; mixing May-archive metrics into the headline matrix is prohibited (May data may only appear in the already-done C3 reproducibility comparison).
If C1-full cannot complete even one full run within budget, fall back to a documented subset (n events stated) and scope the gap as a limitation — never extrapolate or fabricate to fill the matrix.

Paper prose may be drafted in parallel but NO numeric cell is committed to the .tex until its source artifact exists on disk; a final integrity pass must verify every table cell against an artifact path.
key_question_for_managers: What is the measured per-run LLM cost/time of one full C1-full pass via Harness A on the new runs' ground-truth event set, and do ground-truth labels already exist for those new runs (or must they be deterministically derived) — because that single answer decides whether scope is 1, 3, or all 10 runs, and whether the matrix can be built at all without fabrication?
